input.quote: 11.1 Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
input.rationale: Sections 11.2 and 11.3 already meet the data-return and certified-deletion elements (30-day machine-readable return, no fee-dispute hostage, officer-certified deletion after confirmed return). However, § 11.1 provides no transition assistance at all and mandates immediate permanent deletion of Customer Data with no export or migration support, which is squarely in walk-away territory and contradicts §§ 11.2–11.3. The redline replaces § 11.1 with the preferred position (up to six months of assistance at then-current rates plus export/migration support) and defers deletion to §§ 11.2–11.3.

proposal.summary: Replace immediate cessation/deletion in § 11.1 with up to six months of transition assistance and export/migration support, with deletion governed by §§ 11.2–11.3
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept immediate cessation of assistance and permanent deletion of Customer Data on termination, which also contradicts §§ 11.2 and 11.3. We have replaced § 11.1 with our standard position: up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates plus export and migration support, with deletion occurring only under §§ 11.2–11.3. We can work with 90 days of assistance as a fallback.

ops.oldText: Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
ops.newText: On expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates, including export and migration support reasonably necessary to move to Customer or a successor provider. Vendor shall not delete Customer Data except in accordance with Sections 11.2 and 11.3.
